name: Luminous Jellyfish Lantern Festival
description: Thousands of bioluminescent jellyfish released into a calm bay, each carrying a tiny paper lantern.
prompt: Nighttime bay with perfectly still water reflecting the sky. Thousands of translucent jellyfish drift upward, each cradling a miniature glowing paper lantern tied to its bell. Lanterns emit warm amber light; jellyfish pulse with cool blues and greens. Star‑filled sky above. Cinematic, high dynamic range, serene atmosphere.
caption: Lights that swim, dreams that float 🌊🏮 #JellyfishLanterns
